args.title: Saltmarsh Foods — Freight pricing this quarter
args.body:
• Saltmarsh Foods’ latest newsletter highlights its article on freight pricing this quarter and points readers to a companion analysis.
• The article reports that spot freight rates fell 9% while contract rates remained steady; fuel surcharges now adjust in line with weekly diesel prices.
• The companion piece finds that shippers splitting freight volume across three carriers paid the lowest prices.
